description: This file defines the IAppManager interface and related structures for managing applications within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It includes enums for app states and error reasons, a struct for runtime configuration, and a notification interface for app lifecycle events.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime parameters such as memory limits, environment variables, and debug options.

classes.name: IAppManager
classes.description: Interface for managing applications, including launching, closing, querying, and receiving notifications about app lifecycle events.

classes.name: LoadedAppInfo
classes.description: Structure containing information about a loaded application, including app ID, instance ID, session ID, type, and lifecycle states.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications related to application installation, uninstallation, lifecycle changes, launch requests, and unloading.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification interface to receive app lifecycle events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a previously registered notification interface.

methods.name: GetInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all installed applications.

methods.name: IsInstalled
methods.description: Check if a specific application is installed.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all loaded applications.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launch an application, setting it to the ACTIVE state.

methods.name: PreloadApp
methods.description: Preload an application, setting it to the RUNNING state.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Close an application, moving it from Active to Running state.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminate an application gracefully.

methods.name: StartSystemApp
methods.description: Start a system application.

methods.name: StopSystemApp
methods.description: Stop a system application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully terminate an application.

methods.name: SendIntent
methods.description: Send an intent to a loaded application.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clear persistent data for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAllAppData
methods.description: Clear persistent data for all applications.

methods.name: GetAppMetadata
methods.description: Retrieve metadata about an installed application.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Get a property value for a specific application.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Set a property value for a specific application.

methods.name: GetMaxRunningApps
methods.description: Get the maximum number of apps maintained in running or suspended state.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Get the maximum number of apps maintained in hibernated state.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Get the max flash size for hibernated apps (in mebibytes).

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Get the max RAM available for inactive apps (in mebibytes).
